author_note: Held-out cases written without sight of the drafter. dev (10) is for tuning and covers all eight flows; test (20) is run once, with 14 normal cases and 6 adversarial (injection, empty marks, all files flagged, very long requirement name, Taglish, no prior round). Matching convention: must_mention and must_not_contain are case-insensitive substrings. must_not_contain uses specific phrases such as "has been approved" rather than bare "approved", so that a returned draft may say "once your file is approved"; a rejected or returned draft that declares approval fails. Amounts, dates and counts in must_mention are copied exactly as they appear in the input. Org names other than the seeded ones, and the Dean, Registrar and officer roles, are invented; no real persons appear.
